verdict.rationale: Drata has a trust center (SafeBase branding and URL setup, a Trust Center analytics dashboard) and says you can 'manage your trust center programmatically' through its API, alongside continuous control monitoring and policy versioning. Nothing shows the trust center updating itself from the platform; the evidence points instead to API-driven management you would have to build yourself. missing for 10: documented automatic sync of subprocessor lists to the trust center, automated document renewal/expiry handling on the trust center, evidence that live control status flows to the public trust center, independent or hands-on corroboration.
